_readme: Corrections that always win, keyed by url_key. Nothing here is wrong today.
To fix one link: add its key, then run
Fields, all optional: category (one of the eight in src/lib/kb/categories.ts),
topics (array of strings), summary (string). Whatever you write here replaces
what the model decided, on this run and every run after it.
Why a file: the alternative is editing the database by hand, which is how a
collection drifts. This way the correction is reviewable in git and permanent.
The plan is an admin page in the app that edits these same corrections in the
database — open a link, pick a category, done, no file and no command. Until
that exists, this file is the switchboard.
